description: Capabilities for the main DevalCopilot window: window lifecycle and events only. No shell, filesystem, or process capability is granted to the WebView — the sidecar is spawned entirely from Rust setup code (src/main.rs), never through an invokable command, so it needs no ACL entry here. The one custom command the WebView does call, get_launch_session, is an app-defined command and is allowed to every window by default without a separate permission entry.
